name: set_dashboard_filters
title: Set dashboard filters
description: Sets the dashboard filters followed by every widget that does not set its own value. Use 'all' to clear a filter.

range.description: Relative period of the games. Never an absolute date.

opponent.description: One opponent, copied verbatim as it appears in data or in the request (a token such as [Player:1], or a bot name such as Expert). Or all.
